subject.title: Feature request: Shareable cron job templates

question: Should ClawHub support shareable scheduled-job templates as a new first-class package surface, a convention on existing skills/bundles, or defer the idea until OpenClaw defines a runtime install contract?
rationale: The issue is coherent, but implementing it safely requires product and security-boundary choices that source inspection cannot infer from current main.

options.title: Design first-class cron templates
options.body: Add an explicit artifact or family model with preview, consent, moderation, and OpenClaw install semantics before implementation.

options.title: Use existing skills or bundles
options.body: Document a convention for scheduling-oriented skills or bundle plugins without adding a separate cron-template package family yet.

options.title: Defer until runtime support exists
options.body: Keep the request parked until OpenClaw has a stable scheduled-job import/install contract that ClawHub can target.

recommendation.title: Design first-class cron templates
recommendation.body: Add an explicit artifact or family model with preview, consent, moderation, and OpenClaw install semantics before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: The current package/catalog family and product-scope files point to Patrick-Erichsen as the best available routing owner for this decision.
